name: Project 00 / Enterprise Homelab Foundation
description: Three standalone Proxmox VE nodes rebuilt from bare metal and managed from one dashboard. Remote access through Cloudflare Tunnel and Access with no open ports, key-only SSH, 2FA on every admin interface, and least-privilege API tokens throughout.

name: Project 01 / Wazuh SIEM
description: Single-node Wazuh SIEM, manager, indexer, and dashboard, with live agent-based log ingestion. Validated end-to-end: real events, real MITRE ATT&CK technique mapping, no custom rule authoring required to get useful signal out of the box.

name: Project 02 / Active Directory
description: Enterprise Active Directory domain, domain controller, member servers, group policy, providing realistic Windows infrastructure and log sources for the detection engineering work that follows.

name: Project 03 / Sigma Detection Engineering
description: Custom Sigma detection rules authored against real log data from Project 01's SIEM, the detection engineering layer of the portfolio.

name: Project 04 / Velociraptor DFIR
description: Digital forensics and incident response tooling built on Velociraptor, correlating with SIEM data and detection alerts for full investigative workflows.

name: Project 05 / AI-Assisted SOC
description: An AI-assisted layer over the SOC stack, triage support and analysis assistance built on the detection and DFIR tooling from earlier projects. Capstone of the series.
